# 4 Ezra Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Third vision

---

**1** He said to me: Before the circle of the earth began, before the world's gates were hung in place, before the assembled winds blew,

**2** before the voice of thunder ever sounded, before lightning first flashed, before paradise was founded,

**3** before the first flowers appeared, before the forces of motion were set in motion, before the vast hosts of angels were assembled,

**4** before the sky was raised on high, before the firmaments were measured and named, before Zion became the footstool of God,

**5** before the count of the present years began, before the thoughts of today's sinners went astray, before those who treasured faith were sealed —

**6** I planned all of this, and it was made through me and no one else. And in the same way, the end will come through me and no one else.

**7** I said: So when does the division happen? When does the first age end and the next one begin?

**8** He said: Think of Abraham and Isaac — and of the twins born to Isaac: when Jacob came out of the womb, his hand was already gripping Esau's heel.

**9** Esau is the end of this age. Jacob is the beginning of the one that follows.

**10** A human hand is all that fits between the heel and the hand. Don't look for more than that, Ezra.

**11** I said: O LORD, my lord — if I have any grace in your sight,

**12** please, show your servant the completion of the signs you began showing me last night.

**13** He said: Stand up on your feet, and you will hear a resonant, full voice.

**14** And if the ground where you are standing shakes violently —

**15** do not be afraid when it speaks; it is speaking about the end. The very foundations of the earth will understand

**16** that the speech is about them — and they will tremble and quake, for they know their transformation must come.

**17** I stood on my feet and listened. A voice began to speak — its sound was like the roar of many waters.

**18** It said: Look — the days are coming. When I draw near to visit the earth's inhabitants,

**19** when I begin to call to account those who have committed injustice, when Zion's humiliation reaches its lowest point,

**20** and when the seal is set on this passing age — then I will reveal these signs:

**21** The books will be opened before the entire sky for all to see at once.

**22** One-year-old children will speak aloud. Pregnant women will give birth prematurely at three and four months, and those children will live and grow up.

**23** Sown fields will suddenly look like they were never planted. Full granaries will suddenly be found completely empty.

**24** A trumpet will blast. Everyone who hears it will be instantly seized with terror.

**25** Friends will attack each other like enemies. The whole earth and everyone on it will shake in fear at the sound of the thunder.

**26** If the Most High lets me live long enough, I will tell you what I see then; and the chaos among the nations will be in the Most High's hands.

**27** I said: In every case, LORD, this is my question: why was I given this power of understanding in the first place?

**28** I wasn't trying to reach the heights of heaven. I only wanted to understand what happens to us every day: why Israel is the laughingstock of the nations, why the people you loved have been surrendered to godless foreigners, why our ancestral law has been worthless, and why the written covenants have disappeared.

**29** We move through the world like a swarm of grasshoppers. Our life is a source of bewilderment and dread. We aren't even worth saving.

**30** But what about God's name — the name that is called over us? That is what I am really asking about.

**31** He answered: The further you search, the more astonished you will be; because this world is rushing headlong toward its end,

**32** and it cannot hold the promises made to the righteous in future times. This age is saturated with sadness and disease.

**33** The evil planted among us has not yet brought in its full crop; the field sown with wickedness has not yet fully ripened.

**34** And until the evil harvest is fully gathered in, the field of the one who sows goodness cannot be worked.

**35** A single grain of evil was planted in Adam's heart at the start — look at the harvest of wickedness it has produced until now, and think of how much more it will produce before threshing day comes!

**36** Calculate for yourself how much corruption a single evil seed has generated.

**37** When all those countless sheaves are finally cut down — what an enormous threshing floor they will fill!

**38** I said: But how long? When will this happen? Why are our years so few and so bitter?

**39** He answered: Stop trying to race ahead of the Most High. You are only thinking of yourself; the Most High is thinking of multitudes.

**40** Are not the souls of the righteous asking the very same thing in their resting places: LORD, when do I receive my harvest? When does the threshing begin?

**41** And the archangel Jeremiel has answered them: When the count of those like you is complete — for God has weighed the world in a set of scales.

**42** He has measured the times out by measure and counted the seasons by number, and nothing will shift or begin until the full measure is reached.

**43** I said: O LORD above us — we already know all this. But tell me: we who are to be saved, we who will be saved through your ways — when do we enter the inheritance you have promised?

**44** He answered: You will enter it when the number previously spoken is fulfilled. The Most High made this age for many, but the world to come for few.

**45** Here is another comparison, Ezra: ask the earth itself and it will tell you — it produces far more ordinary clay for making pots than it does the rare dust that yields gold. That is how this present age works.

**46** I said: Could you not have created everyone at once — past, present, and future — so your judgment could have arrived sooner?

**47** He answered: The creature cannot outpace the Creator. The world cannot simultaneously contain all who will ever be born into it.

**48** I said: But hasn't it been promised to your servant that you will raise all your creation at once — that those in the earth, those in forgotten graves, those who sank in the sea — will all come back together?

**49** He said: There will be a sign when the womb that was closed opens, and what was stored inside is brought out — for an unborn child cannot emerge before there is room to receive it.

**50** And since you asked me earlier about fire and wind and the day, hear this:

**51** Just as three streams blend their waters into one great river, so at the last many signs will be shown to those who live on earth together.

**52** I said: Lord God, you showed me signs last night, but you did not show me all of them.

**53** Tell me now: when will this land you spoke of be desolate?

**54** He said: When I rise to execute judgment on the earth — then comes the liberation of the righteous and the end of all that the wicked have built.

**55** The sun will not shine on those who abandoned my covenant. The moon will give them no light.

**56** No lightning will appear to them, no starlight will reach them — only darkness and terrifying visions.

**57** But to the righteous the sun will shine with seven times its normal brightness.

**58** I said: LORD, you showed me this land. The Most High made this age for many, but the age to come for only a few.

**59** So are we really going to miss it?
